TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the massive pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() reads pricingRuleRequest and passes it to ABKOR001.executePostMassivePricingRules. The library rejects a null request or a null details list, requires at least two ACT details, rejects duplicated ACT ids or details without entityType or id, validates that effectiveDate.endDate is not before effectiveDate.startDate, checks duplicate pricing rules, and resolves each detail value before inserting data. 2. Decisions and branches: buildMassivePricingRules separates non-ACT and non-CUS details as commonDetails, then creates one pricing rule per ACT detail by copying the input pricing rule without details, copying the common details, and adding the current ACT detail. Duplicate validation branches between exact matches, payment method overlap, regulated duplicates, or continuation when no conflict exists. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() calls ABKOR001.executePostMassivePricingRules, which invokes validateMassivePricingRuleRequest, buildMassivePricingRules, validatePostPricingRule for each generated rule, PricingRuleRepository.insertAudit, PricingRuleRepository.insertMassiveCustomAttribute, and persistNewPricingRule to insert each pricing rule and its details. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: executePostMassivePricingRules converts PricingRuleException into advices with codes ABKO10010420, ABKO10010421, ABKO10010422, ABKO10000404, ABKO10010401, ABKO10010402, ABKO10010415, ABKO10010004, and ABKO00000010, then returns an empty list. After execute() receives the library response, assignSeverityError() sets Severity.EWR when getAdviceList() is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: execute() always calls setPricingrulesresponse with the list returned by the library. When no PricingRuleException is raised, each returned element contains the generated pricing rule id from persistNewPricingRule, the copied effectiveDate, fee, precedenceType, progressiveType, comments, and pricingRuleType, plus the copied details after fillDetailValues resolves their value and a CUS detail with value MASIVA is added.
